hints.title: Contiguous Pointer Simulation
hints.text: Maintain an internal array sized n + 1 and a pointer tracking the next required contiguous index starting at 1.

hints.title: Storing Values and Advancing
hints.text: When insert(idKey, value) is called, place value at index idKey.

hints.title: Chunk Extraction
hints.text: If idKey equals ptr, collect consecutive non-null values while incrementing ptr until an empty slot is reached.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each pointer index is visited and advanced at most once across all N operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the entire array on every insert takes O(N^2) total time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pointer advancement yields linear total time across all insertions.
